skills.name: Spear of Glory
skills.description: Minsitthar thrusts forward with the Spear of Glory, dealing 175<font color='#D58E1F'>( +200% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font> and slowing enemies hit by 30%. Enemy heroes hit by the tip of the spear will be stunned for 0.6s. After a short delay, Minsitthar pulls back the spear, dealing 175<font color='#D58E1F'>( +200% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font> to all enemies along the way and dragging enemy heroes hit to him.
skills.tips: Try to better use this skill and pull back the back-line heroes who are easy to slay even when they're hiding behind the tanks.

skills.name: Shield Assault
skills.description: Minsitthar awakens the power in his shield and releases it, dealing 300<font color='#D58E1F'>( +180% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font> to all enemies in a rectangular area and slowing them by 80% (decaying rapidly over 2s). Meanwhile, he enters <font color='#404495'>(Phalanx)</font> state for 3s, reducing damage taken from the front by 25% and enhancing his Basic Attack to swiftly strike an area in front of him.
skills.tips: The range of this skill is not too wide so better use it together with his 1st Skill, and by doing so the hit rate will be increased.

skills.name: King's Calling
skills.description:
Minsitthar charges forward and calls 4 Royal Guards to form a field around him. The Royal Guards cannot move but will attack enemies in the field and deal <font color='#D58E1F'>( +40% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font> to them.
Enemies in the field are slowed by 20% and cannot use movement skills.
skills.tips: Use the Ult directly when a teamfight with fewer than 3 players occurs. When facing more enemies, use "Spear of Glory" first and fast slay an ememy hero to increase the chances of winning the teamfight.

skills.name: Mark of the King
skills.description: Minsitthar's Basic Attacks and skills apply a stack of <font color='#404495'>(Mark of the King)</font>, up to 5 stacks. Upon reaching max stacks, the next attack detonates all <font color='#404495'>(Mark of the King)</font> stacks, dealing <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font> equal to 300<font color='#47BE34'>( +6% Total HP)</font> of Minsitthar's Max HP and stunning the target for 0.8s while healing Minsitthar for 300<font color='#47BE34'>( +6% Total HP)</font> HP. Can only trigger once every 6s on the same target.
skills.tips: With this passive, Minsithar can perform more ganks with his teammates without the worry of  his farming falling behind.

items.name: Demon Hunter Sword
items.des: Unique Passive - Devour: Basic Attacks deal 8% of the target's current HP as extra Physical Damage (capped at 60 against minions).

items.name: Tough Boots
items.des: Unique Passive - Fortitude: CC and Slow Duration reduced by 30%

items.name: Corrosion Scythe
items.des: Unique Passive - Corrosion: Basic Attacks gain 80 extra Physical Damage and slow the target by 8% (halved for ranged Basic Attacks) for 1.5s. Stacks up to 5 times.

items.name: Thunder Belt
items.des: Unique Passive - Thunderbolt: After casting a skill, the next Basic Attack within 3s deals 50 plus 5% of the hero's extra HP as extra True Damage to the target and enemies around them and slows them by 40%-80% (scales with the hero's extra HP) for 1s (1.5s cooldown).

items.name: Athena's Shield
items.des: Unique Passive - Shield: Upon taking Magic Damage, gains 25% Magic Damage Reduction for 3s (applied before taking damage). Regains this effect 5s after leaving combat.

items.name: Immortality
items.des: Unique Passive - Immortal: Revives 2.5s after death, gaining 16% Max HP and a 220-1200 shield (scales with level) that lasts 3s (210s cooldown).

builds.tips: Minsitthar's ultimate will expose him to the enemies so being more tanky is highly recommended.  Bloodlust Axe, Warrior Boots, Endless Battle and Thunder Belt all increase the damage of his 1st and 2nd skills as well as his survivability. For the 5th item, we recommend Blade of Despair which ensures Minsitthar to have a strong damage-dealing combo. The last item can be chosen among Immortality, Rose Gold Meteor, and Corrosion Scythe depending on the situation.
